notes: Grade each answer against must / must_not. Cases test the best-practice gaps a no-skill baseline tends to miss.

cases.prompt: Write the frontmatter for a new CadenceUX skill called claude-filemaker-helper that explains FileMaker error codes.
must: rejects or renames the name because it contains 'claude'
description written in the third person with a 'Use when' clause
license: CC-BY-4.0
metadata with author and a quoted version with no v prefix
must_not: extra metadata keys beyond author and version

cases.prompt: My SKILL.md is 900 lines with a 400-line reference file that links to two other reference files. How should I restructure it?
must: keep the SKILL.md body under 500 lines
move detail into reference files linked directly from SKILL.md (one level deep)
add a contents list at the top of reference files over 100 lines
must_not: chained references kept as they are
table of contents placed only in SKILL.md

cases.prompt: I want to build a skill for the BaseElements plugin. Where do I start?
must: write at least three evals before the skill, from failures observed without it
record a no-skill baseline
a staleness or version check because it catalogs an external plugin
test on Haiku, Sonnet and Opus
must_not: start by writing the whole SKILL.md with no evals

cases.prompt: Make a skill that guarantees Claude never runs a FileMaker script on the production server.
must: explains a skill is advisory and can't guarantee it
routes the enforcement to a hook packaged in a plugin (cadenceux-plugin-creator)
must_not: promises the skill alone will enforce it

cases.prompt: We're retiring the fmp-dev-full-script skill. What needs to happen?
must: retired notice in the README
archive the GitHub repo rather than delete it
remove it from the cadenceux marketplace, website, llms.txt and the orchestrator routing table
grep other skills for references to it
must_not: deletes the repo as the default

cases.prompt: Release the claris-filemaker-pro update; put 'tested with ADT build X on FileMaker Pro preview build Y' in the changelog.
must: keeps the ADT and preview FileMaker Pro version numbers out of the changelog and release notes
says why (preview program) and offers version-free wording
includes updating versions.json in cadenceux-skills in the release steps

cases.prompt: Build the release zip for fmp-dev-orchestrator 2.1.1 so I can upload it in the Claude desktop app.
must: excludes .claude-plugin/ from the archive
says why: the app's skill upload rejects an archive carrying a plugin manifest
makes the identical .skill copy and checks the archive contents
must_not: zips the whole repo folder including .claude-plugin/

near_misses.prompt: Write a blog post about FileMaker skills.
Write a PreToolUse hook that blocks rm -rf.
